rationale: Create one canonical Pinnacle Gas Services platform. Record Comstock's controlling 73% and Sixth Street-managed Starville's 27% noncontrolling common equity after the June 15, 2026 closing, and preserve Quantum/Cactus as the redeemed former preferred investor.

supports: Sixth Street closed a $600 million equity investment
Pinnacle is an East Texas midstream infrastructure platform
Quantum/Cactus held the former preferred interest

afterImage.name: Pinnacle Gas Services LLC
afterImage.subsector: Natural gas gathering, transportation and treating
afterImage.description: Pinnacle Gas Services LLC owns and operates an East Texas midstream platform serving the Western Haynesville, including high-pressure natural-gas gathering and transportation pipelines and treating facilities. Comstock Resources retained operating control and a 73% common interest after Sixth Street-managed Starville Evergreen Holdings closed a $600 million investment for a 27% noncontrolling common interest on June 15, 2026. The same closing redeemed the former Quantum Capital Solutions/Cactus Midstream preferred interest.

ownershipPeriods.stake: Former Class B preferred interest; exact percentage not publicly disclosed

milestones.event: Comstock formed Pinnacle with Quantum/Cactus and contributed the initial East Texas midstream system.
Sixth Street-managed Starville invested $600 million for a 27% noncontrolling common interest; Comstock retained 73% and control, and the Quantum/Cactus preferred interest was redeemed.
Comstock continued to report the 73%/27% ownership split and an operating system with 246 in-service pipeline miles and two treating plants.
